acceptanceCriteria.text: State management migrated to Resource-based architecture
Monolithic managers (RocketsManager, AppController) decoupled into domain-specific services
Global EventBus implemented for decoupled signaling

snapshot.description: Implement a series of architectural improvements to the Godot codebase to improve maintainability, scalability, and state management.
snapshot.title: Godot Architectural Overhaul
